test.message: The claim submission deadline is 60 days, right?
test.answer: TA/DA claims must be submitted within 30 days of return to headquarters. [KB-02 §5] Claims are submitted on the claims portal with scanned bills, and original bills are deposited with the Accounts Section within 7 days of online submission. [KB-04 §1]
